# Valerian Pereira

> Head of Data Team at BookMyShow, based in Mumbai, India — data platform,
> analytics, data science and personalisation. Fifteen years building and
> running platforms, the last eleven at BookMyShow. Builds developer tooling
> and command-line utilities in the open.

The home page at https://valerianpereira.in/ has two views of the same
content: a SQL console you can query, and a conventional CV below it. Each
Android app also has its own page (listed under Apps). Every fact below is
present in the pages' rendered HTML and in their schema.org JSON-LD.

## Current role

- **Head of Data Team (Engineering Manager III)**, BookMyShow, Apr 2024 –
  present. Leads the data tribe: strategy, platform and delivery for 11
  engineers across four groups — data platform (Databricks and AWS), analytics
  and the reporting and reconciliation systems the business runs on, data
  science, and personalisation. Led the Redshift-to-Databricks lakehouse move
  (Medallion architecture on Unity Catalog, workloads 2x faster) and self-serve
  data on 80+ Genie agents (data-engineering tickets down 90%), featured as a
  Databricks customer story in 2026.

## What the team has shipped

Twelve initiatives, queryable on the page as `SELECT * FROM shipped;`.

Data platform:
- Redshift moved to a Databricks Medallion lakehouse on Unity Catalog; EMR
  jobs rebuilt as Spark pipelines, workloads 2x faster.
- EventStore: an in-house clickstream with an MCP interface, replacing a
  CleverTap dependency at ~40% lower cost.
- 65 legacy back-office reports rebuilt on Databricks Apps reading the lake.
- Daily reconciliation across 18 payment gateways into one report.
- Drop-off widget moved from a third-party SDK onto in-house event data.

Analytics:
- Self-serve data on 80+ Genie agents, cutting data-engineering tickets by
  90%; featured as a Databricks customer story (2026).
- Experiment reporting moved onto analytics data; the experimentation vendor
  scoped down to assignment only.
- AWS QuickSight sunset onto Databricks, which already held the data.
- Agentic workflow replacing a manual customer-data handoff to marketing tools.
- Delta Sharing so partners read data directly instead of waiting on extracts.

Data science:
- Recommendation app moved to Go and Redis; Aerospike dropped from the stack.
- Abusive-review detection and summarisation on LLM APIs, running daily.

## Experience

- Engineering Manager III — Head of Data Team, BookMyShow (Apr 2024 – present).
  Data tribe lead; see above.
- Engineering Manager II, BookMyShow (Feb 2022 – Apr 2024). Led the Data team
  on a multi-TB platform; cut data platform costs by 80%+ with no downtime by
  retiring Cloudera, Qlik, Alteryx, TiDB and Cassandra and standardising on
  Redshift and EMR. Automated 500+ Kafka connectors; led DataEngine for the UAE
  launch; brought in Statsig for experimentation.
- Engineering Manager I, BookMyShow (Apr 2020 – Feb 2022). Cutover lead for the
  move from the Mumbai and Bangalore datacenters to AWS; DataEngine from VMs to
  Kubernetes; cinema data sync across 3,000+ cinemas cut from ~4 hours to ~10
  minutes; relaunched the Superstar loyalty programme (~2M users); shipped
  WatchGuide, an OTT aggregator, in a week at the start of COVID-19.
- Assistant Manager, BookMyShow (Oct 2016 – Apr 2020). Led 10+ engineers on
  DataEngine and the backend APIs for the new app and website; API response
  time cut from ~105 ms to ~35 ms; built IEDB, the movie and OTT content
  database; launched the Amazon partnership feed (2019).
- Senior Software Engineer, BookMyShow (Jun 2015 – Oct 2016). Backend engineer
  on DataEngine (PHP, MySQL, Redis); built the real-time seat-availability
  module on Redis pub/sub, still in production.
- Senior Software Developer, Softaculous (Mar 2013 – Jun 2015). Owned Webuzo,
  the hosting control panel and app stack; published 70+ Webuzo AMIs on the
  AWS Marketplace and built the Cloud Launcher.
- Software Developer, Softaculous (Jun 2011 – Mar 2013). Built 30+ install
  packages for the Softaculous one-click installer and core features in PHP,
  MySQL and JavaScript on Linux.

## Apps

Free Android apps, published as signed Play bundles. No ads, no accounts, no
analytics, no third-party SDKs; nothing leaves the phone.

- **What is this?** — https://valerianpereira.in/what-is-this/ (source:
  https://github.com/valerianpereira/what-is-this-app). Picture-naming game for
  2–4 year olds. A real Wikimedia Commons photo appears, the child says the word
  out loud, and after a 3, 5 or 8 second countdown the phone's own text-to-speech
  says it back. 22 groups, 325 words (Animals, Fruits, Vehicles, Body Parts,
  Toys, School Things, Shapes, Colours and more); ten pictures a round with a
  summary of the words seen. Parent zone behind a 2-second hold: progress per
  group, voice on/off, photo credits, one-tap download of every picture for
  offline use. Built as one vanilla HTML/CSS/JS file (~650 lines) wrapped in a
  Capacitor 8 WebView; photos fetched via jsDelivr and cached by a service
  worker, so the APK is about 4 MB. One permission: INTERNET, for card photos.
- **Tambola: Housie Caller** — https://valerianpereira.in/tambola/ (source:
  https://github.com/valerianpereira/tambola-app). Tambola (Housie) number
  caller that runs on one phone. Calls 1–90 out loud with the traditional
  rhymes ("Legs eleven", "Two little ducks"), shows the full colour-coded 9×10
  board with the last call ringed, auto-calls every 5, 7 or 10 seconds or steps
  manually, undoes the last call, tracks prizes (Early Five, Top/Middle/Bottom
  Row, Full House), keeps counters and a game timer, light and dark themes.
  Fully offline, zero network requests. React 19 + Vite (~1.2k lines), wrapped
  with Capacitor 8 and its TTS plugin.

## Tools

- **School Age Check** — https://valerianpereira.in/school-age/. Admission
  age calculator for Nursery, Jr KG, Sr KG and Class 1 in India. Enter a date
  of birth and it shows which class the child can join in each academic year.
  It defaults to the Maharashtra School Education Department GR of 15 October
  2026 (RTE-2024/Pr.Kr.139/SD-1), which counts age on 30 June instead of 31
  December. The new rule is phased in: Nursery 3+ from 2027-28, Jr KG 4+ from
  2028-29, Sr KG 5+ from 2029-30 and Class 1 6+ from 2030-31. School heads
  can relax this by 15 days, and children already enrolled in 2026-27 are
  exempt. The other options are the KVS/central norm, Delhi, Karnataka,
  Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Tamil Nadu (RTE), West Bengal and Goa. Each one
  links to its source. Runs entirely in the browser.

## Open source

- [backup-action](https://github.com/valerianpereira/backup-action) — GitHub
  Action that backs up MySQL, MongoDB and PostgreSQL databases and directories
  over SSH. 54 stars; published on the GitHub Marketplace.
- [fifa-wc26](https://github.com/valerianpereira/fifa-wc26) — World Cup 2026 in
  the terminal: fixtures, live scores, group standings, ASCII bracket.
- [npx valerianpereira](https://github.com/valerianpereira/npx_valerianpereira)
  — a business card that prints into your shell.
- [who-is](https://github.com/valerianpereira/who-is) — Alexa skill for domain
  WHOIS, expiry and hosting details.
- [alexa-rail-info](https://github.com/valerianpereira/alexa-rail-info) — Alexa
  skill for Indian Railways: cancellations, reschedules, PNR status.
- [webuzo-docker-centos](https://github.com/valerianpereira/webuzo-docker-centos)
  — the Webuzo hosting control panel in a single container.
